scriptData.label: Test

description.label: Description
description.value:
The blow barely grazes your head, unsettling your headgear.

Effects: If completely bareheaded you must pass a Challenging (+0) Endurance Test or gain @Condition[Stunned] (1). If wearing a hat, Leather Skullcap, Mail Coif or Open Helm you gain @Condition[Blinded] (1) as it settles across your eyes. A good full Helm is fitted and strapped on well enough to avoid any effects at all except a ringing noise as the weapon glances off.
